evidence.mechanism: shot-08s: the flow arrow sits above the 20 cm/s tick and a dark slate core forms in the top-centre cluster while the outer branches stay khaki; by shot-20s the arrow drops back near the tick and the dark core persists.
evidence.ambition: shot-08s: one stroke-drawn L-system tree with thin halo strokes, a flow dial and a dark node cluster; few layers and no lighting or material beyond line shading, so ambition stays modest.
evidence.craft: shot-02s: thin slate-teal branch strokes on a khaki ground, mirrored and centred with clean spacing; at full size the dense top cluster becomes a tangle of overlapping lines and the halos are barely visible.
evidence.distinctness: shot-02s: khaki and slate line-drawn coral tree, unlike the apricot sand grid, dendrite text or ochre Penrose tiles of the recent nights; no filled shapes, a fresh palette and a branching grammar.
evidence.polish: shot-02s: the mirrored tree is already composed at full width; by shot-20s the colony shrinks into a margined frame with the dark core still visible, so it resolves, though the caption stays fixed at the bottom.

pairwise_justification: Median Penrose frame at 8s has ochre and rust kites filling the cream field as rich shells; tonight's khaki field holds thin slate lines, and at 8s the dark core is a small tangle that the median's bold fills outclass.

critique.change: Add a second visible layer to the coral at shot-08s, such as a filled khaki boundary-layer wash behind each branch or a tint per shielded node, so the colony reads as more than one line-drawn tree.
Thicken the branch strokes and raise halo contrast in the top cluster so the dark core reads as a shaded pocket at shot-08s rather than a tangle of overlapping thin lines.
Remove the bottom caption and let the flow dial's threshold tick and the dark core spread alone carry the mechanism, so shot-08s shows the stagnant core without explanatory text.
